tools.name: index_overview
tools.description: Descriptive statistics for The Omelette Index: how many places serve a plain omelette, countries/subdivisions/cities published, the global price centre in EUR, and the dearest and cheapest published countries.

tools.name: country_index
tools.description: The omelette price index by country. Without arguments: every published country ranked by price (EUR, trimmed median). With a country: that country's full reading.

tools.name: subdivisions
tools.description: Published state/province readings inside one country, ranked by price, with each subdivision measured against its own country (vsCountryPct).

tools.name: cities
tools.description: Published city readings ranked by price (EUR). Optionally filter by country code or by a substring of the city name.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Side-by-side omelette index readings for two or more countries, ranked by price in EUR.
